meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 把 Linear 接到 Claude 上:选定团队里每个 issue 的评论线程都会成为独立会话,有人在该团队评论时它自动回应,不需要 @ 它。安装过程会复制 Linear 适配器、装依赖并写入配置。
howto.when: 当配置好的 Linear 团队出现新评论时触发——它由 webhook 驱动,该团队每条 issue 评论都会自动交给它处理,无需 @ 提及。

say.text: 用 OAuth 应用身份接入 Linear,不要用我的个人 API key
say.note: 这样它以自己的应用身份发言,不冒充你

howto.what_en: Adds Linear to Claude: every comment thread on an issue in the chosen team becomes its own isolated conversation, and new comments there trigger a reply with no @-mention. The skill also copies in the Linear adapter and writes its credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new comment appears in the configured Linear team — it is webhook-driven, so every issue comment in that team is handled automatically, with no @-mention needed.

say_en.text: Connect my Linear team ENG so the bot replies to issue comments there.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, writes .env.

say_en.text: Set up Linear with an OAuth app identity instead of my personal API key.
say_en.note: Agent posts as the app, not as you.

say_en.text: Run the linear-registration test to check the Linear adapter install.
say_en.note: Reports whether the import or dependency drifted.
